one_sentence_fix: Elevate the Stan Jones pricing data and Dermot Cole calculation to primary-source citations (RCA tariff filing, utility/federal docket) so every counter-evidence point rests on a primary source, pushing Counter-evidence and Source quality to 10.
summary: Clears all six hard-fail checks and scores 8.77 weighted, above the 8.0 threshold. Attribution precise, steelman generous and dossier-consistent, high factual density, voice on-anchor. Only material weakness is two secondary counter-evidence sources (Jones opinion column, Cole blog), capping two criteria at 8. Ships as-is.
